new_possibilities: A third evidential status. The unfolder sorted claims three ways: given by the text, recomputed from the text ('checked') and [guess]. The original has two (measured in Godot, or (editor) and not watched), and the compression has none. Giving every number a status (measured, derived, guessed) would put back the force the compression lost and give the next unfolder a slot to fill.

A checkpoint type: the whole cellular.gd assembled at Stop here. It repairs the reader's main build complaint (terse edit verbs, line order rebuilt by hand) and is cheap to keep as a 'state of the file' block at each stop.

Closing the prediction loop out loud. The bridge prediction in 13.1 and the walker/marble results now meet in one sentence: 'the floor you can cross is not the one that looks most solid but the one that has support where your feet are.' The original only implies that meeting. Keep it as the chapter's last line on the argument.

The ring lives in the rule, not in the body. The unfolder noticed that the collider loop does not wrap, so the ring's two ends become two boxes. That belongs in 'What the floor owes': the author chose one ending for the calculation and another for the floor.
Expected outcomes for the Try section (rules 0, 255, 184), worked from the table. The reader's stuck list asked for something to check against, and the unfolder could derive it from the text alone.

Restoring 'should' in the row-1 prediction showed that a careful unfolder can repair a modal flattened by compression, but only because the next block contradicts it. A 'predict:' marker that keeps the hypothetical mood would protect it on purpose.

The [guess] map as a diagnostic. Every [guess] line in the unfolding marks a place where the compressed text underdetermines the lesson (D key, marble, feed/kill, the seeds chapter, keep/drop of the next stop). The list could drive the next version directly.
lost_vectors: Evidential force. The original is a witness. 'Every message and number on this page comes from running the study in Godot 4.6', 'we did not walk them', 'the table is what our run measured', 'No headset was used and no hand was on the keys: every walk above was the autopilot's'. All of this is gone. Reports became imperatives or promises ('we ran it twice' -> 'Play it twice'; the walker 'was sent to place 2' and arrived 0.08 m from its middle -> 'Press Play: the walker climbs the little stair'). The reader could not tell what was measured from what was promised, and guessed that the halls are walkable.

The mood of a prediction. 'So row 1 should be two cells... the floor should be the same on both sides' became 'So row 1 is two cells... So the floor is its own mirror image.' The hedge is what makes the next output a refutation. The verdicts on the course outline's prediction ('The outline's prediction held'; 'held for one rule and half held for the other') were cut, so the loop keeps its prediction and its data but loses its verdict. 'Which are their own mirror image?' is asked and never answered, because '72 of 187 differ from their mirror' and '90 and 250 differ from their mirror on none' were both cut.

Scope and the thesis. 'The claim, as measured:' marked the chapter's thesis, and 'Our sheet is eleven rows from one seed... the pair stayed the closest: with dead ends, 27 of 187; on a ring of 33 cells and 17 rows, 70 of 561' fenced it. Both are gone, so the thesis reads as one sentence among others, stated without its fence.

Eye against body. The image-difference columns (12.45% .. 4.83%, 'closest in every column') were cut, so 'the eye's closest pair is not the body's' has no eye measurement behind it, only the grid's cell count. The strip's percentages (14.51% for the fault, 13.26% for the fix) were cut too, so 'in the picture the fault and the fix are the same size' became 'change the picture equally'. The reader then read that against tile counts 1 -> 68 -> 37 and could not make sense of it.

Shortcut into system: the course lineage. 'You have all the parts: a packed array, a loop, %, a MultiMesh, a collider'; 'the MultiMesh of the pendulum chapter'; 'x_of() is the chessboard's index'; '% is the chessboard's remainder'; 'It is the seeds chapter again'. All of these were cut. The needs: headers keep the dependencies as bare names but not as a path through the course, and the reader guessed 'randomness chapter' for 'seeds'.

Agency. 'Both are our decisions; the pattern has no part in them' became 'Both are yours'. The collider line and the one-tenth threshold sit in the supplied part of diffusion.gd, so the student made neither decision. The compression moved authorship from the kit's authors onto the reader, which blunts the chapter's closing point that an author still chose the edge, the seed and what counts as there.

Premise against confirmation. In the original the CA_Introduction board 'shows the loop this lesson is built on, and says what it is for' before any code is written. The compression moves the quote to after the repair, so the hall agrees afterwards instead of announcing the purpose. The CA_EdgeOfChaos quote ('Every cell reads the previous volume') is lost.

Reasons attached to rules. 'A guest may name nothing outside its own folder' survives, but its consequence ('its script is your cellular.gd with its colour written out') does not. 'D to the right until it stands before the seed' became 'D, then W'. 'Replace add_child(row) with these two lines' became an ambiguous insert. 'Keeps the idea of a rule applied to its own result and drops the grid' became just 'a function that calls itself'. The walker's walk_to(points) and its endings (arrived, blocked, fell, stopped), the instrument behind every walk number, were cut from the borrowed parts.
readability: Line by line it was easy: the code survived word for word, the reader rebuilt the whole script, recomputed the counts, and scored 14.5/16 on the quiz with only three answers unsure. It was hard at the joints: terse edit verbs, needs/gives headers nobody explains, halls and a marble that appear without introduction, and claims whose evidence was cut ('equally', 'balanced by weight') gave 25 stuck points. Readable as sentences, underdetermined as a lesson.
